definition: The step of the house's journey you are on now, drawn as a gilt ring round a gilt dot. Gilt is the one struck highlight on the instrument, and here it marks where you stand.
basis: docs/ui-redesign-2026-10-29.md, the journey marks the redesign ruled: "gilt ring with a gilt dot / dark tile with a gilt border". The same note keeps the gilt for one duty, "the one struck highlight `--gilt #AF8D49` for the active station". workbench/app/src/theme/tokens.css states the mark beside its token: "done is a vellum disc, the step in hand a gilt ring round a gilt dot".
